title: SynCircuit: Automated Generation of New Synthetic RTL Circuits Can Enable Big Data in Circuits
problem: Scarcity of circuit design data limits AI-assisted IC design. Existing generative models cannot reliably generate valid HDL circuits with correct digital logic.
motivation: Circuit dataset availability is the primary bottleneck preventing ML model scaling in automated design.
method: The method uses a diffusion-based generative model (an AI trained to reverse the process of corrupting data) to create circuit designs represented as directed acyclic graphs—connection diagrams with no loops. Constraint refinement then validates that the generated circuits follow valid digital logic rules. Finally, Monte Carlo tree search (a strategic exploration technique) removes redundant components to optimize each circuit.
key_novelty: The core idea is using a diffusion-based generative model to automatically generate circuit designs represented as directed acyclic graphs, with constraint-guided refinement to ensure the generated circuits follow valid digital logic.
contributions: Customized diffusion model for directed acyclic graph generation in HDL
Constraint-based refinement to ensure circuit validity
MCTS-based optimization for logic redundancy reduction
Demonstration of improved downstream ML model performance
limitations: Not discussed; limited to combinational logic generation without timing constraints mentioned.
primary_theme: synthetic circuit generation for design automation
